title: Flaming Swords X Advanced Netherite
description: this is a texture pack created with AI that adds different visual effects for the fire aspect enchantment from the ressource pack Flaming Swords along with adding the effect for the other tiers of the mod Advanced Netherite based on the tier
body:
# Flaming Swords X Advanced Netherite

### Adds compatibility between [Flaming Swords](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/flaming-swords) and [Advanced Netherite](https://modrinth.com/mod/advanced-netherite)

this pack aim at improving Mr_Expence's ressource pack "Flaming Swords" which add a visual for the enchantment fire aspect on mace and swords, being a little flame that moves; however the basic one doesnt support the mod Advanced Netherite. this addon adds flame based of the tier of the weapon.
the flame for the mod are the colour of the tier + black little flames to remind of the netherite.
this is only an addon to Mr_Expence's pack
**BIG SHOUTOUT TO: Mr_Expence who gave me permission to make this pack based on his**
